PROJECT_NAME.description: Project name (used for paths, user, group, etc.)

SYSTEM_USER.description: System user to run the service as

SYSTEM_GROUP.description: System group for the service user

CONFIG_FILE.description: Path to the main configuration file

UWSGI_INI_PATH.description: Path to the uWSGI configuration INI file

UWSGI_INI_APP.description: Path to the uWSGI app entrypoint (for existence check)

UWSGI_PORT.description: Port for uWSGI to bind to

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_FILE.description: Optional config file from which to read IP, port, and workers

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_SECTION.description: Section in UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_FILE to read from

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_WORKERS_DIRECTIVE.description: INI directive for number of worker processes

USE_SYSLOG.description: Set to 'yes' to log to syslog instead of file

USE_LOGFILE.description: Set to 'no' to disable logfile logging
